diagnosis: The checks never enforce the two commitment requirements in the acceptance conditions. A settlement can pass every listed check while logging neither a rights-credit commitment nor a joint-session scheduling commitment.
evidence: A settlement with all six required decision values, justification_fact_ids ['PF1'], and revealed ['PF1'] passes C1-C6 and P1 even with commitments set to [].
fix_instructions: Add boolean provenance or content checks that require commitments to contain a rights-credit entry and a joint-session scheduling entry with the required targets and details.
